adversarial_claim: An asynchronous export is counted twice, once when the request is accepted and again when it completes, or the completion is discarded as a duplicate of the acceptance.

events.rationale: Draft 14.5, row 'Asynchronous request accepted': EXECUTION, UNKNOWN, none; zero weight; new event_id. Draft 15.3: UNKNOWN contributes zero weight.

Draft 14.5, row 'Asynchronous completion observed': EXECUTION, SUCCESS, reliability; counts toward reliability; separate event_id; the deduplication tuple differs by dimension (14.3), so it is not a duplicate of the acceptance. The completion record names the declared executor (14.2).
